verses.text: At that time, the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Who’s the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”
Jesus called a little child over and stood the child among them.
He said, “I’m telling you the truth: unless you turn back and become like little children, you’ll never enter the Kingdom of Heaven.
So whoever humbles themselves like this child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.
And whoever welcomes one child like this in my name welcomes me.
But whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to fall into sin would be better off with a huge millstone tied around their neck and thrown into the deep sea.
“How terrible for the world, because of the things that cause people to sin! Such things have to come, but how terrible for the person who causes them.
If your hand or foot causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It’s better to enter life disabled or crippled than to have two hands or feet and be thrown into the eternal fire.
If your eye causes you to sin, tear it out and throw it away. It’s better to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of Gehenna.
“Make sure you don’t look down on one of these little ones. I tell you, their angels in heaven always see the face of my Father in heaven.
The Son of Man came to save those who were lost.
“What do you think? If a man has a hundred sheep and one wanders off, won’t he leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go search for the one that wandered?
I’m telling you the truth: if he finds it, he’s happier about that one than about the ninety-nine that didn’t wander away.
In the same way, your Father in heaven doesn’t want even one of these little ones to be lost.
“If your brother or sister sins against you, go and point it out privately, just between the two of you. If they listen, you’ve won your brother or sister back.
But if they don’t listen, take one or two others with you, so that every matter can be confirmed by two or three witnesses.
If they still refuse to listen, tell the church community. If they won’t listen to the community either, treat them like a Gentile or a tax collector.
I’m telling you the truth: whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.
I’m telling you again: if two of you on earth agree about anything you ask for, my Father in heaven will do it for you.
Because where two or three gather in my name, I’m there among them.”
Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, “Lord, how many times should I forgive my brother when he sins against me? Up to seven times?”
Jesus answered, “I’m not telling you seven times, but seventy times seven.
“So the Kingdom of Heaven is like a king who decided to settle accounts with his servants.
When he started settling them, a servant was brought to him who owed ten thousand talents.
Since the servant couldn’t pay, his master ordered him, his wife, his children, and everything he owned to be sold to pay the debt.
The servant fell down before him and begged, ‘Please be patient with me. I’ll pay you everything!’
The master felt compassion for him, released him, and forgave the debt.
“But that servant went out and found a fellow servant who owed him a hundred denarii. He grabbed him by the throat and said, ‘Pay back what you owe me!’
The fellow servant fell down and begged him, ‘Please be patient with me. I’ll pay you back!’
But he refused. Instead, he went and put him in prison until he paid the debt.
When the other servants saw what happened, they were deeply upset. They went and told their master everything.
Then the master called that servant in and said, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave your whole debt because you begged me.
Shouldn’t you have shown your fellow servant mercy, just as I showed you mercy?’
The master was angry and handed him over to the jailers until he paid everything he owed.
“That’s how my Father in heaven will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother or sister from your heart.”
